title: Hit kind clarity: Assault Cannon, anti-fighter barrage, Courageous, Space Cannon, bombardment
description: What each hit decision now says: the source, whether it is a destroy or a normal hit, which ships may take it, and whether Sustain Damage applies. Before shots are the real-game captures of BJ-combat-decisions; after shots are synthetic fixtures through a mocked server (the engine now sends a display-only context.hit; the web falls back to the subtype for older payloads).

shots.heading: Assault Cannon, desktop 1440x900: before
shots.caption: Real engine game (BJ capture, Hacan attacker): generic combat view, the header still reads 'Retreat / next round', nothing names the card or says it is a destroy.

shots.heading: Assault Cannon, desktop 1440x900: after
shots.caption: Banner names the source (Assault Cannon), says the opponent destroys 1 of YOUR non-fighter ships, 'Destroy, not a hit', 'Cannot be sustained', 'Non-fighter ships only'. Fighters and infantry are dimmed with 'Not a legal target' (tooltip: cannot be assigned). Rows say 'Click to destroy'. Synthetic fixture through the mocked server.

shots.heading: Anti-fighter barrage window, desktop 1440x900: before
shots.caption: Real engine game (BJ capture): the raw label 'when ANTI FIGHTER BARRAGE STARTED' above the Waylay offer, no explanation.

shots.heading: Anti-fighter barrage window, desktop 1440x900: after
shots.caption: Banner: 'Anti-Fighter Barrage: before <roller> rolls', explaining that every barrage hit destroys one opposing fighter automatically (nobody is asked, no sustain, extra hits are lost) and that Waylay is the exception. The raw label is replaced by 'Before the barrage dice are rolled'.

notes.title: Raw strings in the Vortex / Cabal agent / Stillness decisions:
notes.text: the BJ real-game shots show 'VTX', 'CABALAGENT' and 'sol_infantry' as option or prompt text. They come from the faction content's labels, not the combat UI; list for a separate labels pass.

notes.title: Staged hit panel on a phone:
notes.text: the plus buttons of the Assign hits rows are clipped at 390px width when a row has a capacity label (visible in the Waylay and Space Cannon shots).

notes.title: Bombardment hits on ground forces:
notes.text: assign_ground_casualty still uses the generic ground-combat view; only the target pick was clarified.

notes.title: After shots are synthetic:
notes.text: no real-engine game was driven for them, so the real path is covered by the engine test (context.hit on assault_cannon_destroy) and the vitest rendering tests.
